description_en: Queries the port forwarding rules that are created for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例下已创建的端口转发规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-port --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-7e225i410000 --frontend-protocol tcp --frontend-port 55 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePort

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the forwarding protocol to query. Valid values:

tcp
udp
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的转发协议类型。取值：

tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: frontend_protocol

parameters.help_en: The forwarding port to query. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的转发端口。取值范围：0~65535
parameters.name: frontend_port

parameters.help_en: The page number. For example, if you want to obtain results on the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则设置1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页包含的记录数量
parameters.name: page_size

NetworkRules.description_en: An array that consists of port forwarding rules
NetworkRules.description_zh: 端口转发规则配置列表

BackendPort.description_en: The port of the origin server

FrontendProtocol.description_en:
The type of the protocol. Valid values:

tcp
udp
FrontendProtocol.description_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the port forwarding rule is applied
InstanceId.description_zh: 转发规则所属的DDoS高防实例的ID

IsAutoCreate.description_en:
Indicates whether the port forwarding rule is automatically created by the instance. Valid values:

true: yes
false: no
IsAutoCreate.description_zh:
该规则是否由DDoS高防自动生成。取值：
true：表示由DDoS高防自动生成。
false：表示由您手动创建

RealServers.description_en: An array that consists of IP addresses of origin servers

items.description_en: The IP address of the origin server

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The number of port forwarding rules returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回的端口转发规则的数量
